prose: Debian launched an Inference Portal, a self-service portal where Debian Developers and Maintainers get LLM inference, manage API keys and track budget. It was announced on September 23 and added scaleway/qwen3.8-27b on September 25, with DebGPT configuration docs.
highlights: Self-service LLM inference for Debian contributors.
Limited to Developers and Maintainers; login via Salsa.
